AdminSafehouse.label: Admin safehouses
AdminSafehouse.description: Allows administrators and moderators to claim safehouses.

SafehouseDaySurvivedToClaim.label: Required survival days
SafehouseDaySurvivedToClaim.description: Number of in-game days a player must survive before claiming a safehouse.

SafeHouseRemovalTime.label: Inactive removal period
SafeHouseRemovalTime.description: Removes a safehouse when none of its members have visited it for the specified number of real-world hours.

DisableSafehouseWhenPlayerConnected.label: Protect only while offline
DisableSafehouseWhenPlayerConnected.description: Disables safehouse protection while any member is connected.

SafehouseAllowTrepass.label: Allow trespassing
SafehouseAllowTrepass.description: Allows non-members to enter safehouses without an invitation.

SafehouseAllowLoot.label: Allow looting
SafehouseAllowLoot.description: Allows non-members to loot containers and move objects in safehouses.

SafehouseAllowRespawn.label: Allow respawning
SafehouseAllowRespawn.description: Allows members to choose their safehouse as a respawn location.

SafehouseAllowNonResidential.label: Non-residential safehouses
SafehouseAllowNonResidential.description: Allows non-residential buildings to be claimed as safehouses.

FactionDaySurvivedToCreate.label: Required survival days
FactionDaySurvivedToCreate.description: Number of in-game days a player must survive before creating a faction.

FactionPlayersRequiredForTag.label: Members required for a tag
FactionPlayersRequiredForTag.description: Number of faction members, including the owner, required to create a faction tag.

PublicName.label: Server name
PublicName.description: Name shown in the in-game and Steam server browsers.

PublicDescription.label: Server description
PublicDescription.description: Description shown in the in-game and Steam server browsers. Use \n to start a new line.

Public.label: Public listing
Public.description: Lists the server in the in-game public server browser. Steam-enabled servers remain visible in the Steam server browser.

Open.label: Open server
Open.description: Allows players without an existing whitelist account to join. When disabled, accounts must be created by an administrator.

MaxPlayers.label: Maximum players
MaxPlayers.description: Maximum number of regular players connected at once. Values above 32 may cause poor map streaming and desynchronization.

AutoCreateUserInWhiteList.label: Create accounts on join
AutoCreateUserInWhiteList.description: Adds unknown usernames to the whitelist when they join an open server. Players provide their own username and password.

MaxAccountsPerUser.label: Accounts per Steam user
MaxAccountsPerUser.description: Maximum number of accounts one Steam user can create. Does not apply when using the Host menu.

DropOffWhiteListAfterDeath.label: Remove account after death
DropOffWhiteListAfterDeath.description: Removes a regular player's whitelist account after death, preventing them from creating another character on a closed server.

AllowNonAsciiUsername.label: Non-ASCII usernames
AllowNonAsciiUsername.description: Allows usernames containing non-ASCII characters, such as Cyrillic letters.

AllowCoop.label: Split-screen players
AllowCoop.description: Allows additional local players to join through split-screen co-op.

DefaultPort.label: Player port
DefaultPort.description: Primary UDP port used by players to connect to the server.

UDPPort.label: Additional UDP port
UDPPort.description: Secondary UDP port used for player communication.

UPnP.label: Automatic port forwarding
UPnP.description: Attempts to configure port forwarding automatically on a UPnP-compatible router.

server_browser_announced_ip.label: Advertised IP address
server_browser_announced_ip.description: IP address advertised by the server in network setups with multiple addresses.

PauseEmpty.label: Pause when empty
PauseEmpty.description: Pauses game time while no players are connected.

SleepAllowed.label: Allow sleeping
SleepAllowed.description: Allows players to sleep; this does not make sleep necessary.

SleepNeeded.label: Require sleeping
SleepNeeded.description: Makes players become tired and require sleep.

FastForwardMultiplier.label: Sleep time speed
FastForwardMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the passage of time while players sleep.

PlayerRespawnWithSelf.label: Respawn at death location
PlayerRespawnWithSelf.description: Allows a local player to respawn where their previous character died.

PlayerRespawnWithOther.label: Respawn with another player
PlayerRespawnWithOther.description: Allows a local split-screen or Remote Play player to respawn at another player's location.

ShowFirstAndLastName.label: Show character names
ShowFirstAndLastName.description: Displays character first and last names above player characters.

MouseOverToSeeDisplayName.label: Names on hover only
MouseOverToSeeDisplayName.description: Shows a player's display name only while pointing at them.

SteamScoreboard.label: Steam identity visibility
SteamScoreboard.description: Controls who can see Steam usernames and avatars in the player list.

MinutesPerPage.label: Minutes per book page
MinutesPerPage.description: Number of in-game minutes required to read one page of a book.

BloodSplatLifespanDays.label: Blood stain lifetime
BloodSplatLifespanDays.description: Number of in-game days before old blood stains are removed when their map chunks load.

RemovePlayerCorpsesOnCorpseRemoval.label: Clean up player corpses
RemovePlayerCorpsesOnCorpseRemoval.description: Includes player corpses when the world's corpse-removal interval runs.

TrashDeleteAll.label: Delete all from bins
TrashDeleteAll.description: Allows players to permanently delete all contents of a bin.

SpeedLimit.label: Vehicle speed limit
SpeedLimit.description: Maximum speed vehicles can reach on the server, in km/h.

CarEngineAttractionModifier.label: Engine noise attraction
CarEngineAttractionModifier.description: Multiplier applied to the distance at which vehicle engines attract zombies. Lower values may reduce server load.

HoursForLootRespawn.label: Loot respawn interval
HoursForLootRespawn.description: Number of in-game hours after which previously looted containers can respawn loot.

MaxItemsForLootRespawn.label: Loot respawn item threshold
MaxItemsForLootRespawn.description: Containers with this many items or more are not eligible to respawn loot.

ConstructionPreventsLootRespawn.label: Construction blocks loot respawn
ConstructionPreventsLootRespawn.description: Prevents loot from respawning in zones marked by player construction or modification.

ItemNumbersLimitPerContainer.label: Items per container
ItemNumbersLimitPerContainer.description: Maximum items players can place in a world container, including items inside nested containers.

AllowDestructionBySledgehammer.label: Allow sledgehammer destruction
AllowDestructionBySledgehammer.description: Allows players to destroy world objects with sledgehammers.

SledgehammerOnlyInSafehouse.label: Sledgehammers in safehouses only
SledgehammerOnlyInSafehouse.description: Restricts players to destroying world objects inside their own safehouses.

PVP.label: Allow PvP
PVP.description: Allows players to hurt and kill other players.

SafetySystem.label: Player safety system
SafetySystem.description: Allows each player to enter or leave PvP mode individually.

ShowSafety.label: Show PvP status
ShowSafety.description: Displays a skull icon above players who have entered PvP mode.

SafetyToggleTimer.label: PvP toggle duration
SafetyToggleTimer.description: Real-world seconds required for a player to enter or leave PvP mode.

SafetyCooldownTimer.label: PvP toggle cooldown
SafetyCooldownTimer.description: Real-world seconds added after an unsafe player attacks, delaying safety reactivation.

PVPFirearmDamageModifier.label: PvP firearm damage
PVPFirearmDamageModifier.description: Percentage modifier applied to firearm damage against other players.

PVPMeleeDamageModifier.label: PvP melee damage
PVPMeleeDamageModifier.description: Percentage modifier applied to melee damage against other players.

PVPMeleeWhileHitReaction.label: Melee during hit reactions
PVPMeleeWhileHitReaction.description: Allows a player to make another melee attack while reacting to a hit from another player.

PlayerBumpPlayer.label: Player collisions
PlayerBumpPlayer.description: Allows running players to bump into and knock over other players.

KnockedDownAllowed.label: Allow knockdowns
KnockedDownAllowed.description: Allows players to be knocked down.

SneakModeHideFromOtherPlayers.label: Sneaking hides players
SneakModeHideFromOtherPlayers.description: Makes sneaking players harder for other players to see.

HidePlayersBehindYou.label: Hide players outside view
HidePlayersBehindYou.description: Hides players outside the character's field of view, like zombies.

ServerWelcomeMessage.label: Welcome message
ServerWelcomeMessage.description: Message shown in chat when a player joins the server.

GlobalChat.label: Global chat
GlobalChat.description: Allows players to communicate with everyone through global chat.

ChatStreams.label: Available chat channels
ChatStreams.description: Chat channels players can use on the server.

AnnounceDeath.label: Announce player deaths
AnnounceDeath.description: Posts a global chat message whenever a player dies.

BanKickGlobalSound.label: Ban and kick sound
BanKickGlobalSound.description: Plays a global sound when a player is banned or kicked.

VoiceEnable.label: Voice chat
VoiceEnable.description: Allows players to communicate using voice chat.

Voice3D.label: Directional voice audio
Voice3D.description: Positions voice chat audio according to the speaker's location.

VoiceMinDistance.label: Full-volume distance
VoiceMinDistance.description: Distance in tiles within which voice chat is heard at full volume.

VoiceMaxDistance.label: Maximum voice distance
VoiceMaxDistance.description: Maximum distance in tiles at which voice chat can be heard.

DisableRadioStaff.label: Mute all staff radios
DisableRadioStaff.description: Prevents radio transmissions from players with any staff access level.

DisableRadioGM.label: Mute GM radios
DisableRadioGM.description: Prevents radio transmissions from game masters.

DisableRadioInvisible.label: Mute invisible-player radios
DisableRadioInvisible.description: Prevents radio transmissions from invisible players.

DiscordEnable.label: Discord chat integration
DiscordEnable.description: Connects global text chat to a configured Discord channel.

Map.label: Maps
Map.description: Semicolon-separated map folder names loaded by the server.

SpawnPoint.label: Fixed spawn point
SpawnPoint.description: World coordinates where every new player spawns, in x,y,z format.

SpawnItems.label: Starting items
SpawnItems.description: Items given to new players when they spawn.

MapRemotePlayerVisibility.label: Player visibility on map
MapRemotePlayerVisibility.description: Determines which remote players appear on the in-game map.

WorkshopItems.label: Workshop item IDs
WorkshopItems.description: Semicolon-separated Steam Workshop item IDs downloaded by the server.

Mods.label: Mod IDs
Mods.description: Semicolon-separated mod IDs loaded by the server.

SaveWorldEveryMinutes.label: Automatic save interval
SaveWorldEveryMinutes.description: Saves loaded parts of the world after the specified number of real-world minutes.

BackupsOnStart.label: Back up on startup
BackupsOnStart.description: Creates a backup when the server starts.

BackupsOnVersionChange.label: Back up on version change
BackupsOnVersionChange.description: Creates a backup when the server starts with a different game version.

BackupsPeriod.label: Periodic backup interval
BackupsPeriod.description: Time in real-world minutes between periodic backups.

BackupsCount.label: Backups to keep
BackupsCount.description: Maximum number of backups retained for each backup type.

ResetID.label: Reset ID
ResetID.description: Generated world-reset identifier used to determine whether existing characters remain compatible.

ServerPlayerID.label: Server player ID
ServerPlayerID.description: Generated server identifier used to determine whether a character belongs to this server.

DenyLoginOnOverloadedServer.label: Reject logins while overloaded
DenyLoginOnOverloadedServer.description: Rejects new login attempts while the server is too busy to process them.

LoginQueueEnabled.label: Login queue
LoginQueueEnabled.description: Queues players and admits them to the server one at a time.

LoginQueueConnectTimeout.label: Queue connection timeout
LoginQueueConnectTimeout.description: Seconds given to an admitted player to complete the connection before the queue moves on.

PingLimit.label: Ping limit
PingLimit.description: Maximum ping in milliseconds before a non-privileged player is removed.

KickFastPlayers.label: Remove unusually fast players
KickFastPlayers.description: Removes players detected moving faster than normally possible. This check may produce false positives.

PerkLogs.label: Perk change logs
PerkLogs.description: Records changes to player perk levels in PerkLog.txt.

ClientActionLogs.label: Logged client actions
ClientActionLogs.description: Semicolon-separated client action names to record in ClientActionLogs.txt.

ClientCommandFilter.label: Client command log filter
ClientCommandFilter.description: Semicolon-separated include and exclude patterns controlling which client commands are recorded in cmd.txt.

DoLuaChecksum.label: Game file validation
DoLuaChecksum.description: Kicks clients whose game files do not match the server.

AntiCheatProtectionType1.label: Unauthorized PvP
AntiCheatProtectionType1.description: Checks whether player-versus-player attacks are permitted.

AntiCheatProtectionType2.label: Movement speed
AntiCheatProtectionType2.description: Checks for movement exceeding the permitted speed.

AntiCheatProtectionType2ThresholdMultipl.label: Movement speed threshold
AntiCheatProtectionType2ThresholdMultipl.description: Multiplies the threshold used by movement-speed validation.

AntiCheatProtectionType3.label: Interaction distance
AntiCheatProtectionType3.description: Checks for interactions over an invalid distance.

AntiCheatProtectionType3ThresholdMultipl.label: Interaction distance threshold
AntiCheatProtectionType3ThresholdMultipl.description: Multiplies the threshold used by interaction-distance validation.

AntiCheatProtectionType4.label: Attack damage
AntiCheatProtectionType4.description: Checks for attacks dealing excessive damage.

AntiCheatProtectionType4ThresholdMultipl.label: Attack damage threshold
AntiCheatProtectionType4ThresholdMultipl.description: Multiplies the threshold used by attack-damage validation.

AntiCheatProtectionType5.label: Zombie ownership
AntiCheatProtectionType5.description: Checks whether a client is authorized to control the affected zombie.

AntiCheatProtectionType6.label: Player ownership
AntiCheatProtectionType6.description: Checks whether the affected player belongs to the sending client.

AntiCheatProtectionType7.label: Safehouse authorization
AntiCheatProtectionType7.description: Checks whether a player is authorized for the affected safehouse.

AntiCheatProtectionType8.label: Unauthorized packets
AntiCheatProtectionType8.description: Enforces access requirements for restricted network packets.

AntiCheatProtectionType9.label: XP gain rate
AntiCheatProtectionType9.description: Checks for experience gained at an excessive rate.

AntiCheatProtectionType9ThresholdMultipl.label: XP gain threshold
AntiCheatProtectionType9ThresholdMultipl.description: Multiplies the threshold used by experience-gain validation.

AntiCheatProtectionType10.label: Unknown network messages
AntiCheatProtectionType10.description: Checks for unrecognized low-level network messages.

AntiCheatProtectionType11.label: Protection type 11
AntiCheatProtectionType11.description: Reserved, undocumented anti-cheat option with no behavior identified in Build 41.

AntiCheatProtectionType12.label: Invalid player flags
AntiCheatProtectionType12.description: Checks for restricted player-state flags received from clients.

AntiCheatProtectionType13.label: Unknown game packets
AntiCheatProtectionType13.description: Checks for unrecognized game packet types.

AntiCheatProtectionType14.label: XP target ownership
AntiCheatProtectionType14.description: Checks whether a client is authorized to modify the target player's experience.

AntiCheatProtectionType15.label: XP amount
AntiCheatProtectionType15.description: Checks for excessive experience changes received from clients.

AntiCheatProtectionType15ThresholdMultip.label: XP amount threshold
AntiCheatProtectionType15ThresholdMultip.description: Multiplies the threshold used by experience-amount validation.

AntiCheatProtectionType16.label: Prohibited fire
AntiCheatProtectionType16.description: Checks for attempts to start fire when fire is disabled.

AntiCheatProtectionType17.label: Invalid fire placement
AntiCheatProtectionType17.description: Checks for attempts to start fire in an invalid location.

AntiCheatProtectionType18.label: Invalid smoke placement
AntiCheatProtectionType18.description: Checks for attempts to create smoke in an invalid location.

AntiCheatProtectionType19.label: Duplicate safehouses
AntiCheatProtectionType19.description: Checks for attempts to create another safehouse for the same owner.

AntiCheatProtectionType20.label: Safehouse size
AntiCheatProtectionType20.description: Checks for safehouses exceeding the permitted dimensions.

AntiCheatProtectionType20ThresholdMultip.label: Safehouse size threshold
AntiCheatProtectionType20ThresholdMultip.description: Multiplies the maximum safehouse dimensions used by validation.

AntiCheatProtectionType21.label: Recipe checksum mismatch
AntiCheatProtectionType21.description: Checks for recipe data that does not match the server.

AntiCheatProtectionType22.label: Recipe checksum timeout
AntiCheatProtectionType22.description: Checks for clients that do not return recipe validation in time.

AntiCheatProtectionType22ThresholdMultip.label: Recipe validation timing
AntiCheatProtectionType22ThresholdMultip.description: Multiplies the delays and timeouts used by recipe validation.

AntiCheatProtectionType23.label: Time multiplier mismatch
AntiCheatProtectionType23.description: Checks for a client time multiplier that does not match the server.

AntiCheatProtectionType24.label: Time multiplier timeout
AntiCheatProtectionType24.description: Checks for clients that do not return time-multiplier validation in time.

AntiCheatProtectionType24ThresholdMultip.label: Time validation timeout
AntiCheatProtectionType24ThresholdMultip.description: Multiplies the timeout used by time-multiplier validation.
